Title
* Please avoid the word "Fibonacci", as these sequences aren't actually Fibonacci sequences.

Goal
* I suggest modifying the task so that the output no longer requires a comma.

* Please rewrite as follows:

Create a string from a given number [[n]] and of length [[l]].

• The string starts with two digits, both equal to [[n]].
• The string is extended by appending the sum of the final two digits so far, until the length reaches [[l]].
• If the string becomes too long when appending the result at the final step, remove the final digit(s) so that the length is exactly [[l]].

<<Example>>
If [[n]] = 3 and [[l]] = 8, we build the string as follows:

• 33
• <<33>>6 (3 + 3 = 6)
• 3<<36>>9 (3 + 6 = 9)
• 33<<69>>15 (6 + 9 = 15)
• 3369<<15>>6 (1 + 5 = 6)
• 33691<<56>>11 (5 + 6 = 11)

As 336915611 has length 9, the final digit is removed to obtain the answer {{33691561}}.

Input & Output
* Please remove all occurrences of "Fibonacci".

Constraints
* Please change 1000 to 100.

Solution
* Please remove the comma from the output.

Cases
* Please remove all commas from the expected outputs of all cases.

* Please use similar values of [[l]] in the cases, e.g.

  • Test/Validator 1: [[l]] = 4 / 5

  • Test/Validator 2: [[l]] = 10 / 9

  • Test/Validator 3: [[l]] = 13 / 15

  • Test/Validator 4: [[l]] = 20 / 18

* Please increase [[l]] gradually across the case pairs.

Thanks.

Hello, 
thanks for all your remarks and advices. All is done. Have you got any athor remarks or advice ?

The cases are good, but the solution and the expected outputs need to be fixed.

* Validator 10: Please remove the trailing newline from the output.

* All cases: The output should be exactly of length [[l]]. For example, the answer for Test 1 should be 1123 instead of 11235.

Thanks.
